body.x: Nexon-GSOK successfully completes the 2022 thesis contest

body.cap: Nexon-GSOK Paper Contest Award Ceremony | Image courtesy of Nexon

body.x: Nexon announced the successful completion of the 2022 Nexon-GSOK thesis contest co-hosted by the GAME SELF-GOVERNANCE ORGANIZATION OF KOREA (GSOK).

The contest exhibit was held in an attempt to boost academic research in the gaming industry, the theme of which was “Influence of Nexon games on domestic society, economy, and culture.” The contest ran from June 9 of this year to September 18 and received a total of 18 theses. Experts from various fields assessed each thesis and handpicked three different papers for a prize (The grand prize is KRW 3 million, the excellent prize is KRW 2 million, and the participation award is KRW 1 million).

The grand prize went out to the team of Bae Sung-hoon, Cho Sung-geun, and Bae Joon-hee of Kyungpook National University, who submitted a paper under the theme of” ‘How does the combination of mode and IP lead to user participation?: Focus on Basic Consciousness and Experiential Creative Needs.” This paper received favorable reviews for its analysis of the impact of the existing IP use of mode production games on user participation with the case study on Maple Story World.

The excellent prize went to the team of Lee Soo-hyun and Kim Yong-woon of Hankuk University of Foreign Studies. Their thesis was “The impact of e-sports on the recognition of professional sports clubs online brands and the number of spectators at home games: focusing on FIFA Online eK League and K League.” The study of this paper focused on the effect of professional sports clubs’ participation in e-sports on sports clubs’ online brand awareness, spectators, and sales.

The team of Jeon Sung-eun and Jeong Se-wook of Kangwon National University became the winner of the participation award for their study. The theme of the paper was “Expression of Nexon’s Creative City, Focusing on Analysis of Nexon Maple Story.”
They analyzed Maple Story to study the location of modern cities and the justification of games as a third place in preparation for the loss of social capital.
Nexon announced its research results and held an award ceremony at the Center for Law &Technology -GSOK Joint Seminar at BEXCO in Busan during G-Star on the 18th of this month.

An official from Nexon said this seminar was first held this year, co-hosted by Nexon and GSOK, and found a variety of novel research themes in different perspectives.” And he added, “We will continue to take responsibility and make much more efforts to conduct in-depth studies in the gaming industry.”
Tapas Entertainment, Kakao Entertainment’s North American Base, Participated in ‘Anime NYC’ in New York

Tapas Entertainment, Kakao Entertainment's North American corporation, participated in “Anime NYC”, one of the most famous animation events held in New York, USA, to introduce Kakao Entertainment's outstanding story IP capabilities.

Kakao Entertainment announced on the 22nd, that Tapas Entertainment, the North American base for story intellectual property rights, participated in Anime NYC held from the 18th to 20th, and successfully finished the event. Anime NYC, an animation festival held in New York City, normally attracts tens of thousands of global fans, various publishers, exhibitions and panels from all over the world every year. This year, more than 50,000 global fans from Canada, Mexico, England, France, Germany, Australia, China, Brazil, and Japan visited the event.

Tapas’ ‘Beginning after the End’ stole the show at the event. Beginning after the End is Tapas’ original IP discovered by Tapas Entertainment in the US, and a super IP that has built a large North American fandom with Kakao Entertainment's “novel comics system”, which turns popular web novels into webtoons. A Korean-American author, TurtleMe, wrote the original web novel, and Fuyuki 23 added a beautiful sketch to turn it into a webtoon. The work depicts the exciting story of Arthur, who was a king in his previous life, then reincarnated in a new world full of magic and monsters and starts his new life.

Both the web novel and the webtoon ranked first in Tapas, and have been translated into six languages, including Korean, Japanese, and French, and are loved worldwide on various webtoon and web novel platforms. In addition, the webtoon was published as a book in the United States, where comics’ publications are mainstream, and received great responses. Recently, Beginning after the End also launched as an audiobook and made a hit, making another successful IP expansion case.

In particular, on the first day of the event, about 400 people gathered for the talk show featuring author TurtleMe, and fans gathered so much that the Tapas Entertainment’s booth overflowed. Author TurtleMe, who got a round of applause after pretending to be a staff member then suddenly came on stage, said, “As I met fans from around the world, including Korea, Japan and the U.S., how much ‘The Beginning after the End’ is being loved worldwide is clearly showing.” He added, “I would love to have more meetings with fans in the future.”

That day, author TurtleMe also drew attention by announcing the news of the additional publication of the book, Beginning after the End, which had alredy gained great popularity along with the web novel and the webtoon. He decided to publish the volume 2 to 6 in succession by 2024 with Yen Press, the publisher of the first book. Yen Press is one of the largest publishers of comics and novels in North America. Author TurtleMe held a signing event as well as a live talk show with Reddit, the largest community website in the United States, followed by interviews with local media over the three days. Then he had a meeting with Yan Press, the publisher of the book 'The Beginning after the End'. Other various events such as an autograph session with Kinokuniya Bookstore, were held to communicate with the novel’s fans.

An official from Tapas Entertainment said, “Even just a few years ago, there were few booths that were related to webtoons and web novels and brought a lot of attention. However, Now looking at the long lines and countless crowds to meet the author TurtleMe, I could see the potential of 'beginning after the end' as well as the bright future of the webtoon and web novel market.” He added, “We will develop North American story IP business based on Korean webtoons and web novels as well as super IPs just like Beginning after the End.”
Softlanders officially launches work support platform to assist their overseas employees
After completing MVP verification over the past two years, Softlanders officially launched Korea’s first one-stop relocation platform.

Softlanders is a platform that helps dispatched executives and employees adapt by providing integrated services necessary for overseas working environments. It plans to provide full support with regard to the dispatch of overseas companies, from short-term business travelers to overseas residents.

It provides services other companies find difficult, such as airline tickets, short-term accommodation, car rentals to overseas directors, visa issuance, overseas insurance, local real estate contracts, and vehicle purchases. In particular, the platform can increase work efficiency by providing a package that combines services frequently used when traveling abroad.

Softlander’s platform allows the expenses used for overseas dispatch to be settled at a single counter, and all previous dispatches are recorded in the system. So even if there are personnel changes, the dispatched personnel overseas can be managed without difficulty.

This September, the company sales doubled compared to last year and have continued to grow more than 30% of transactions and sales since 2022. In addition to large and medium-sized companies such as Hive, Hanwha Q Cells, SK Specialty, Wemade, and Motrex, new innovative companies are using Softlanders’ relocation services to send long- and short-term talent overseas and overseas businesses.
To commemorate the platform launch, the company is holding an event where discounts or fee exemptions for some services are available to membership subscribers until the end of the year.

A pharmaceutical company’s HR manager who is one of the users of Softlanders said, “We have used Softlanders for overseas dispatch for two years,” and explained, “We have reduced the cost by 25% as well as reduced the time required for support work by more than 90%.

Meanwhile, Softlanders is a global relocation start-up that was selected as a start-up package support project by the Ministry of SMEs and Start-ups in 2022 and received customized support such as commercialization and mentoring from the Gyeonggi Creative Economy Innovation Center.
LIG Nex1 Develops AI-based “Integrated Automation Technology that supports the Submarine Combat System Mission”

LIG Nex1 signed a business agreement for ‘Integrated Automation Technology for Intelligent Mission Support System for Submarines’ worth KRW 39.6 billion, which was supervised by the Defense Technology Promotion Research Institute.

Through this project, LIG Nex1 will become the first in Korea to develop and apply artificial intelligence technology to the main core functions of the combat system to intelligently automate a series of processes such as 'detection and tracking → identification and risk assessment → armament allocation and tactical operation → engagement and evaluation'.

If the next-generation submarines are equipped with an AI-based automated mission support system, the system is expected to greatly contribute to improving the survivability and combat power of the submarines that mainly carry out the operation alone.

In addition, it is expected to guarantee the ability to perform combat by effectively relieving fatigue caused by operational complexity while assessing the condition based on the Big Data and making decisions.

LIG Nex1 is building the optimal infrastructure through industry-academia-research cooperation, such as specialized companies (Cocklel), research institutes (Korea Ocean Science and Technology Institute), and schools (Korea University, Hanyang University, Sejong University), based on the existing submarine weapon system development experience and technology. The companies is also now developing a combat system that incorporates the latest artificial intelligence technology suitable for the submarine operation environment by integrating the capabilities of each field.

Krafton’s Battleground, European Natus Vincere Wins at PGC 2022, Top International Esports Competition

The PGC 2022 Grand Final was held from the 17th to the 20th at the Dubai International Exhibition Center located in Dubai, United Arab Emirates, with spectators. After the fierce competition over 20 matches over four days, Europe's Natus Vincere became the 2022 PUBG Esports World Champion with a total of 179 points.
Natus Vincere swept as many as three chickens for 4 days, becoming the first PGC champion in the team’s career and the first PGC winning team in Europe.
The MVP of the tournament was Natus Vincere’s “xmpl” Artem Adakin. Xmpl contributed greatly to the team's victory by recording a total of 32 kills and 15 assists in the Grand Final alone.
Gyeonggi Center for Creative Economy & Innovation Wins CES 2023 Innovation Awards

One of the start-up global expansion support projects operated by the Gyeonggi Center for Creative Economy & Innovation is the “Global Star Venture”. As a project that has been steadily ongoing since 2018, it provides supports to startups through ▲exhibition application consulting, ▲product promotion video and photo shooting, ▲award strategy seminars, and opens up the possibility of overseas expansion such as the US CES Innovation Award and the Edison Award. Following last year's 14 innovation awards, out of total 16 companies awarded this time, 9 companies were the beneficiaries of the "Global Star Venture", which once again achieved remarkable results.

Shin Hyeon-sam, head of the Gyeonggi CCEI, said, “The center has considered its core role discovering and nurturing start-ups that have overseas market potential within the business world for the past five years.” He added, "We plan to actively utilize our skills accumulated in this role to support our start-up companies' global expansion."
Nexon Releases ‘Civilization: Reign of Power’ simultaneously in Asia
Nexon Co., Ltd. announced that it will simultaneously release 'Civilization: Reign of Power', a new mobile game developed by Endream Co., Ltd., in Asia on the 29th of this month.

Civilization: Reign of Power is a new game introduced as the first mobile multi-access online simulation game (MMOSLG) by utilizing the IP of 'Civilization', a worldwide steady seller game. It is based on Civilization 5, a popular game among the Civilization series, and inherits the three victory conditions of Civilization (conquest, science, culture) and key elements such as historic figures. In addition, the game’s strength is that it adds to the fun of MMO games by providing federation-level competition, large-scale PvP wars, and content for each season, which are all unique features of Civilization: Reign of Power.
